items.title: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
items.summary: Postman has been found to automatically install AI plugins that may compromise user data by attempting to share all API data without explicit consent. This raises significant security concerns for developers relying on Postman for API testing and management.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.summary: The latest version of Qwen allows users to interpret model weights directly on their laptops, enhancing accessibility for developers working with large language models. This development could democratize AI model training and experimentation.

items.title: Stringman, an $800 open-source room scale gripper robot
items.summary: The introduction of Stringman, an affordable open-source gripper robot, presents new opportunities for developers and engineers in robotics and automation. This project encourages collaboration and innovation in the field of robotics by providing accessible hardware solutions.

items.title: Fujifilm to boost tape production 5x as AI fuels archiving demand
items.summary: Fujifilm is ramping up tape production by five times to meet the growing demand for AI-driven archiving solutions. This move highlights the intersection of traditional storage technology and modern AI applications, signaling a shift in data management strategies.

items.title: Safari introduces Adaptive Dark Mode in 27.3
items.summary: Safari's new Adaptive Dark Mode feature enhances user experience by automatically adjusting to ambient light conditions. This update is significant for web developers as it encourages the adoption of dark mode designs, improving accessibility and user comfort.
